caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your quick ChatGPT query might be using way more power than you think!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 A single ChatGPT query consumes about 10 watt-hours of electricity.
🔹 That's roughly 10 times more than what a standard Google search uses in a DAY.
🔹 Running advanced AI models like GPT-4 requires thousands of powerful NVIDIA GPUs, consuming megawatts of power!
